title: Rajni Bala v. Regional Transport Authority

brief.about: The appellant challenges refusal to renew her stage carriage permit on the Rampur to Kalka route on the ground of two pending challans. Issue notice.
brief.last: Reply is filed. The appellant states both challans stand compounded and produces receipts. The respondent is directed to verify the receipts.
brief.today: Listed for verification report and final arguments.
